name: havencare
description: HavenCare — tooling root. Not a workspace: frontend/ and backend/ keep their own package.json and their own CI job.

scripts.db:seed: docker exec -i $(docker ps -qf name=supabase_db) psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/seed.sql
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it $(docker ps -qf name=supabase_db) psql -U postgres -d postgres
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > backend/src/db/types.ts
